title: Apollo and Athena plan a duel
intro: Apollo and Athena meet at the oak and agree to stop the fighting for the day. Helenus overhears their plan.

notes.text: ἀλλήλων, each other: dat pl; τώ, nom dual, those two; συναντάομαι, meet: 3du aor mid.
φηγός, oak: dat sg; the oak by the Scaean gate, later a Trojan landmark.
τήν, her; πρότερος, first (adj used as adv); προσεῖπον, address: 3sg 2aor with epic ε-lengthening.
τίπτε, why then; μέμονα, be eager: perf ptc nom fem sg; θύγατερ, voc of θυγάτηρ.
ἔρχομαι, come: 2sg 2aor; ἀνίημι, urge on: 3sg aor, with μέγας θυμός as subject.
ἦ, interrogative “is it that”; ἑτεραλκής, giving strength to the other side: acc sg fem, a victory that swings.
Δαναοί, Greeks: dat pl; δίδωμι, give: 2sg aor subj, purpose after ἵνα.
ἀπόλλυμι, perish: pres mid ptc acc pl; ἐλεαίρω, pity: 2sg pres, “you do not pity the Trojans.”
πείθομαι, obey + dat: 2sg aor opt mid; τι adverbial, “in any way.”
κερδίων, more profitable: comparative; εἴη 3sg opt, potential with κεν.
παύω, stop: 1pl aor subj, hortative; δηϊοτής, hostile fighting: acc sg.
μαχέομαι, fight: 3pl fut mid, elided; τέκμωρ, goal / end: acc sg.
εἰς ὅ κε, until; εὑρίσκω, find: 3pl aor subj; Ἰλίου, of Ilios, the end of Ilios.
πέλομαι, be / prove: 3sg aor; ὣς φίλον ἔπλετο, “so it was pleasing to.”
ἀθάνατος, immortal: epic dat pl fem with ὑμῖν; διαπέρθω, sack: 2aor inf, epic -έειν.
ἔστω, 3sg imperative, “so be it”; ἑκάεργος, far-working: voc, epithet of Apollo.
φρονέω, intend: pres ptc nom fem sg, uncontracted; τά, these very things.
μετά + acc, among.
ἄγε, come now; μέμονα, intend: 2sg perf with present sense.
καταπαύω, put a stop to: fut inf, epic -έμεν.
ὄρνυμι, rouse: 1pl aor subj, hortative.
μένος, might; ἱππόδαμος, horse-taming: gen sg.
ἤν = εἰ ἄν, if; που, perhaps; τινά, acc object of the challenge.
προκαλέω, challenge: 3sg aor subj mid, epic -σσ-.
οἰόθεν, from alone / by himself; οἶος, alone: pleonastic.
ἀντίβιος, face to face: adverbial acc; μάχομαι aor inf.
αἰνός, grim: dat sg fem; δηϊοτής, fighting.
ἀγάομαι, admire / be roused: aor ptc nom pl, epic -σσ-; χαλκοκνήμιδες, bronze-greaved.
ἐπόρνυμι, urge on: 3pl aor opt; “they might rouse one man to fight.”
οἶος, alone: acc sg, one man; δῖος, godlike: dat sg.
φημί, say: 3sg impf, unaugmented-looking; ἀπιθέω, disobey: 3sg aor.
τῶν, their (gods’); Ἕλενος, Helenus, Priam’s prophet son.
συντίθεμαι, take in / grasp: 3sg 2aor mid; θυμῷ, in his mind.
βουλή, plan; ἐφανδάνω, please: 3sg impf, augment lengthened to ἐφήν-.
μητιάω, plan: pres ptc dat pl, uncontracted; “the plan that pleased the gods as they planned it.”
ἵστημι, stand: 3sg root aor; εἶμι, go: pres ptc nom sg.
μιν, him; εἶπον, say: 3sg 2aor with epic doubled ε-.
voc phrases; ἀτάλαντος, equal in weight: voc sg + dat Διί; μῆτις, counsel: acc of respect.
